title: Triangulation of the compatible uniform complete category
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, $A=\mathcal O_E$ its valuation ring, $\varpi$ a uniformizer, $I=(\varpi)$, and $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$. Let $T$ be a noetherian scheme of finite dimension on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the completed coefficient sheaf $A_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$ and the derived category $D(T_{\Proet},A)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. The full subcategory $\Dbc(T_{\Proet},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], defined by derived completeness, uniformly bounded constructible reduction towers with common adic-lisse finite-type local models, and compatible etale-origin witnesses, contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, all integer shifts, and cones of every morphism between its objects. With the inherited shift and the ambient distinguished triangles whose vertices lie in it, it is a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]; its inclusion into $D(T_{\Proet},A)$ is exact. This assertion concerns the compatible uniform tower category, not merely levelwise bounded constructibility or the constant-coefficient category.
